body.name: Finite-sample simultaneous bounded-mean rectangle
body.construction: \(\mathcal R_{1-\eta}=\prod_{e\in\mathcal E}([\widehat\mu_e-\rho_{h(e)},\widehat\mu_e+\rho_{h(e)}]\cap[\underline y,\overline y])\times\prod_{j\in\mathcal J}([\widehat\nu_j-\rho_{g_j},\widehat\nu_j+\rho_{g_j}]\cap[\underline y,\overline y])\), with a zero-count factor replaced by \([\underline y,\overline y]\).
